summary: An accountancy practice that promises no penalty fines appears to lose new clients to a cluttered menu, leftover placeholder text and a typo in the pricing area.

findings.problem: The main menu appears to list Advertising Page about eleven times, next to internal items such as Time Sheet, PAYE details and Employees Registration Form.
findings.cost: A new client cannot find your services in a menu this long, and staff pages in a public menu look careless for a firm that handles money.
findings.fix: A short menu with five or six clear services.

findings.problem: Placeholder Latin text, Quisque rhoncus ut mauris, appears in the footer area.
findings.cost: Leftover template text makes the site look unfinished, and clients doubt a firm that leaves it on show.
findings.fix: Clean footer with your real details.

findings.problem: The business plan prices appear to carry the typo Busniess Plan and uneven price formatting.
findings.cost: A typo in the area where a client decides to buy lowers trust and sales.
findings.fix: Clear price cards with a simple next step.

redesign: Clean price cards and an enquiry form.
